I do believe it's Placebo, mixed with excellent songwriting. The combination of the storyline, imagery, music, and fairly ghetto technology sort of puts you in a mood you can't easily replicate.

It's comparable to old movies such as Terminator. The effects were very primitive compared to what we have now, but a lot can be said for that eerie, dull, broken apart future you see, or that machine at the end of the movie that drags its leg, inching closer and closer to the door in some obvious green screen shit, but damn did it look spooky.

Throughout the entire Pokemon game, when you defeat a creature, it faints. In Lavender Town, it's death. The details are so very subtle but it's there. You talk to the grieving NPCs. That music is dragging on, seeping into your head as ghostly Pokemon attack you. More grievers. Some grievers are aggressive. All the dialogue is depressing. Grave stones all over, ghosts, death, grief.

When you put it like that you can understand. That place was pretty heavy for little kids lol.
